name: coding
description: Progressive Guardrails output style, the write-test skill with its four test agents (black-box tests gated on the break they catch, proved by mutation), the remove-code skill, the guardrail skill (turns a rule stated in words into a lint rule, type, git hook, CI step, agent hook or permission rule), the node-native skill (what the current Node LTS replaces in a codebase, each claim proved by a probe), the lib-creator skill (a library package from the decision that it should exist to the last consumer that moves onto it), and the update-docs skill with its docs-analyst, docs-writer and docs-judge agents (each library project's docs kept current from evidence, every draft judged blind before its commit).
